_comment: Ports allowed to listen on a non-loopback address. Everything else (Qdrant, Redis, exporters, testctl, Postgres) must bind 127.0.0.1 or the Docker subnet. Adding a port here needs a reason; ops_selfcheck.py fails on any 0.0.0.0/:: listener not listed. Owner decision pending: whether the UI/API ports below should also go loopback-only (they are reachable from the LAN and Tailscale today; binding them shut would cut phone/laptop access).

ports.8006: ada-backend API/UI (owner LAN/Tailscale access; app-level auth)
ports.8080: erpnext-frontend (A finance app UI, own login)
